mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freelancer_profiles ( freelancer_id, nickname, introduction, school_name, major, degree, grad_status, github_url, website_url, is_profile_complete ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{dto.nickname}, #{dto.introduction}, #{dto.schoolName}, #{dto.major}, #{dto.degree}, #{dto.gradStatus}, #{dto.githubUrl}, #{dto.websiteUrl}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT freelancer_id, nickname, introduction, github_url, website_url, school_name, major, degree, grad_status, is_profile_complete FROM freelancer_profiles WHERE freelancer_id = #{freelancerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE freelancer_profiles SET nickname = #{nickname}, introduction = #{introduction}, github_url = #{githubUrl}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, school_name = #{schoolName}, major = #{major}, degree = #{degree}, grad_status = #{gradStatus}, is_profile_complete = #{isProfileComplete} WHERE freelancer_id = #{freelancerId}
